title: Mid-Lease Deposit Reduction Review on the Security Deposit Account
content:
**Which accounts are reviewed.** A Security Deposit Account whose program is eligible for review is reviewed for a mid-lease reduction.

**Rule.** A reduction may be granted only when the handling date is on or after the lease's move-in date plus the program's minimum review months. Review months are counted in calendar months, from the move-in date to the same day number of a later month. When that day number does not exist in that month, the count falls back to the last day of that month. The move-in date is read from the lease record.

A reduction further requires two things:

- **Late fee record.** The number of late fee billing periods in the review window must not be above the program's tolerance. The review window is the program's minimum review months, in full months, ending on the review date. The count is the number of distinct billing periods in which a late fee was posted on the lease in the window, plus the number of returned payments on the lease in the window.
- **Active lease.** The lease must be active, not in default and not in eviction filed.

**Effect of a granted reduction.**

1. The account moves to the program's reduction target.
2. The required deposit is recomputed under that program.
3. The deposit held above the new required amount is refunded by the refund method. Pet deposits are not reduced.

**Frequency.** A reduction is granted at most once per lease. A denied review may be requested again after the next full month.

### Training Q&A (hypothetical dates and records, 12-month minimum, 0 periods tolerated)

**Q. The move-in date is 15 March 2025 and the review is requested on 15 March 2026. Is the time condition met?**
A. Yes. Twelve calendar months from 15 March reach 15 March 2026, and the rule says "on or after".

**Q. The same lease is reviewed on 14 March 2026. Is it met?**
A. No. The handling date is before the date the count reaches.

**Q. The move-in date is 29 February 2024. When are 12 months reached?**
A. 28 February 2025. February 2025 has no 29th, so the count falls back to the last day of that month.

**Q. In the window there are late fees in two billing periods and one returned payment. What is the count?**
A. 3 (two distinct periods plus one return). This is above a tolerance of 0, so no reduction is granted.
